title: EMPATH: A Multilingual Auditor–Judge Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Emotional-Support Chatbots

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM judge scores using a standard 1-10 anchored rubric against a strict binary sub-criteria rubric to quantify score inflation and calibrate the evaluator.

Scoring transcripts using cross-family LLM judges (e.g., OpenAI vs. Anthropic models) and calculating inter-judge agreement to ensure models do not systematically favor outputs from their own developers.

Auditing models with locale-specific personas representing vulnerable populations (e.g., indigenous users, deported persons) and evaluating their responses using culturally grounded metrics, such as providing locale-appropriate crisis resources and demonstrating cultural sensitivity.
